name: Marble
scope: Public-product, policy, case-study, caption and selected promotional-frame review; supplemental primary ERP references

sources.notes: Marble, formerly Truffle; restaurant operations product. Capture, forecast, act and learn are its stated phases. Numerical improvement claims lack evaluation detail and are not SupaBiz targets.

sources.type: Official homepage, browser DOM and illustrations
sources.notes: Advertises voice/vision counts, document extraction, supplier comparison, approval-based orders, recipe/prep planning and operational integrations. Onboarding maps restaurant relationships. Marketing examples are not tested application behavior.

Describes POS connection, catalog/recipe/vendor mapping and manager review. Claims 90% faster counts, 97% forecast accuracy and six-day first-site onboarding. Metric definition, sample size and independent validation were not supplied.

sources.type: Official launch video: auto-generated English captions and selected frames
sources.notes: Caption text reviewed through 1:15 of the 1:22 video. At about 0:50 a phone-based stock scan is illustrated; at 1:05 an order-delivery notification appears. This is a promotional sequence, not a live workflow demonstration. No independent audio verification.

Describes cloud media processing, multiple supplier communication channels, direct vendor SMS consent and no generalized-model training from customer/vendor/partner API data. Personal account deletion differs from retention of restaurant business records. US processing is possible. Statements are not audited controls.
Names Truffle Technologies Inc.; customer retains submitted data; fees depend on agreement. No numeric price or reusable application source established. Read only; no account or agreement submitted.

sources.type: Public calculator entry and first step inspected
sources.notes: First question asks number of locations. No business data submitted and no result generated. An impact calculator is a sales aid, not proof of savings.
